value.title: Seats with no role in the view (workstream 007 s04)
value.summary: `pij directory` lists every live seat in the project that holds no role, each with the command that assigns it one or closes it.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: `pij directory` lists every live seat in the project that holds no role, each with the command that assigns it one or closes it.

value.claim: A live seat whose folder belongs to the project (the same match `pij directory` uses for its caller) and that holds no open holding there is an action `no-role` naming the seat with `pij directory assign <role> <seat>` and `pij close <seat>`. The designated prime is never listed.
After it is assigned, the action is gone.

value.title: Seats with no role in the view (workstream 007 s04)

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: The view in community/directory.rs reads live seats once per view (http/directory.rs live_seats); match_project maps a folder to a project.

value.risk: A seat in a shared worktree maps to two projects.
value.mitigation: The same longest-repo rule as the caller's own project.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: per view: in-process path checks per live seat (no launch). No loop, poll or timer.
No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
